container.evidence: Outer dimensions: selected variant in dataset/hestia-rl/sand_container/New Text Document.txt. Opening: matching 2/1 row in selected size-table image. Taper, thickness and corner radii are image-based estimates. Open container only; lid omitted at user request.

scale.evidence: Body envelope and pan dimensions are printed on the selected product-size image. Pan orientation follows its wider transverse side. Internal support, feet, housing slopes and pan thickness are estimates. Square blue pan follows the photographed protective-film appearance; round pan is silver.

bowl.evidence: Approximate 120 x 60 mm envelope from RealSense frame 20261013_153506_636313. Revised against side frame 20261013_153452_094806 and interior frame 20261013_153433_495185: curved heel, narrow raised foot, thin wall and flared pale rim. Profile and thickness are visual estimates, not measured. Envelope uncertainty remains about +/-10 mm.
